headline: State Park Capacity and Waterfall Trail Access
reservation: Entry to popular sites like Table Rock and Caesar's Head requires a per-person or per-vehicle daily fee payable at self-service kiosks or visitor centers. While hiking permits are not required for most day use, specific backcountry camping sites on the Foothills Trail must be reserved in advance; popular trailheads often reach capacity by mid-morning on weekends.

days.title: The Granite Escarpment

stops.name: Table Rock State Park
stops.detail: Challenge yourself with the hike to the summit for iconic views of the reservoir and the 'Blue Wall'.

stops.name: Bald Rock Heritage Preserve
stops.detail: Step onto a massive granite outcropping for a panoramic, no-hike view of the mountains.

days.driving: Allow 45–60 minutes; roads are winding mountain two-lanes.
days.note: The Table Rock summit hike is strenuous; allow at least 5 hours for the round trip.

days.title: Vistas and Vertical Cascades
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from Caesar's Head Visitor Center

stops.name: Caesar's Head Overlook
stops.detail: Take the short walk to the cliff edge for a 1,200-foot drop view into the Dismal Forest.

stops.name: Raven Cliff Falls
stops.detail: Trek through hardwood forest to see South Carolina's tallest waterfall from a suspension bridge or overlook.

days.driving: Allow 30 minutes between parks; conditions vary with mountain fog.
days.note: Parking at Raven Cliff Falls is separate from the main Caesar's Head lot and fills quickly.

days.title: Rivers and Regional Heritage

stops.name: Jones Gap State Park
stops.detail: Explore the Middle Saluda River, a scenic mountain waterway ideal for cooling off and birdwatching.

stops.name: Hagood Mill Historic Site
stops.detail: Witness a 19th-century water-powered grist mill and prehistoric petroglyphs in a quiet forest setting.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for local transfers; narrow roads require slow speeds.
days.note: Jones Gap often requires a pre-booked parking reservation during peak summer weekends.

intel.title: State Park Capacity
intel.text: Table Rock and Jones Gap lots frequently reach capacity by 10 AM on Saturdays. Have a secondary trail plan or arrive when the gates open to ensure access.

intel.title: Topographic Interference
intel.text: Cellular reception is spotty in the deep valleys of Jones Gap and along the Foothills Trail. Download offline maps at the visitor centers before heading to the trailheads.

intel.title: Mountain Service Gaps
intel.text: Fuel is plentiful in Travelers Rest and Pickens but unavailable along the Highway 11 corridor through the parks. Top off your tank before beginning the climb to Caesar's Head.

intel.title: Waterfall Volume
intel.text: Late spring provides the highest water volume for Raven Cliff Falls. During dry summer months, some smaller cascades may reduce to a trickle.

intel.title: Pretty Place Schedule
intel.text: Symmes Chapel (Pretty Place) is a private facility often closed for weddings. Always verify the weekly schedule on the YMCA Camp Greenville website before driving up.

plan.arrival: Fly into GSP or PDK, pick up a rental, and head to Travelers Rest for supplies and regional maps before checking into your mountain cabin or glamping site.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are fine for Highway 11, but high-clearance is helpful for some gravel heritage preserve roads.
plan.goldenHour: Pretty Place (Symmes Chapel) is the premier sunrise location, while Caesar's Head offers long shadows over the valley at sunset.
